detail.longDescription: I'm making a video player in which I can use the right / left arrow keys to skip the video forward / backward 5 seconds. This was simple enough to do initially using QShortcuts , but I wanted to develop it to keep skipping the video while the key is held down. This became sluggish, so I used a short QTimer to debounce setting the video position, but then ran into the problem that while the video was still playing, it would jump back to its playing position while I'm doing the skipping. So, my problem is, I want to pause the video when the arrow key is first pressed, keep skipping while it auto-repeats, and resume playing when the key is released. My first go at this was to use an eventFilter . This didn't work because the KeyPress events were moving the focus between the child widgets and were never reaching my eventFilter , although the KeyRelease events were. This was where my original question came from - turned out I was misunderstanding eventFilters , I thought they intercepted events before they reached the child widgets. An answer on the original question which has now been deleted, suggested installing eventFilter on the QApplication instead. This worked, but I was advised to avoid this, and realised I would run into problems with the eventFilter catching key events for every window in my actual app. On closer testing when I was putting this question together, I also found that KeyRelease event was happening after every time the KeyPress auto-repeated, even though the key hadn't been released. Original code using eventFilter : import os import datetime from PyQt6 import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets, QtMultimedia, QtMultimediaWidgets class VideoPlayer(QtWidgets.QWidget): def __init__(self, path): super().__init__() self.resize(800,600) self.setWindowTitle(os.path.basename(path)) self.media_player = QtMultimedia.QMediaPlayer() self.media_player.setSource(QtCore.QUrl.fromLocalFile(path)) self.media_player.positionChanged.connect(self.setSeekBarPosition) self.media_player.durationChanged.connect(self.setDuration) self.media_player.playbackStateChanged.connect(self.setPlayPauseButton) self.video_widget = QtMultimediaWidgets.QVideoWidget() self.video_widget.setSizePolicy(QtWidgets.QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QtWidgets.QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding) self.media_player.setVideoOutput(self.video_widget) self.play_pause_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton(QtGui.QIcon(self.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.StandardPixmap.SP_MediaPlay)), "") self.play_pause_btn.clicked.connect(self.togglePlayPause) self.position_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel("0:00:00") self.seek_bar = QtWidgets.QSlider(QtCore.Qt.Orientation.Horizontal) self.seek_bar.setSizePolicy(QtWidgets.QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QtWidgets.QSizePolicy.Policy.Minimum) self.duration_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel("0:00:00") controls_layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout() controls_layout.addWidget(self.play_pause_btn) controls_layout.addWidget(self.position_lbl) controls_layout.addWidget(self.seek_bar) controls_layout.addWidget(self.duration_lbl) main_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self) main_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0) main_layout.addWidget(self.video_widget) main_layout.addLayout(controls_layout) play_pause_shortcut = QtGui.QShortcut(QtGui.QKeySequence("space"), self) play_pause_shortcut.activated.connect(self.togglePlayPause) self.playing_before_skip = False self.key_filter = VideoKeyFilter() self.key_filter.key_pressed.connect(self.skipKeyPressed) self.key_filter.key_released.connect(self.skipKeyReleased) self.key_filter.skip.connect(self.skip) self.installEventFilter(self.key_filter) self.position_debounce_timer = QtCore.QTimer() self.position_debounce_timer.setSingleShot(True) self.position_debounce_timer.setInterval(50) self.position_debounce_timer.timeout.connect(self.setVideoPosition) def setSeekBarPosition(self, position): self.seek_bar.setValue(position) sec = int(position / 1000) self.position_lbl.setText(str(datetime.timedelta(seconds=sec))) def setDuration(self, duration): self.seek_bar.setRange(0, duration) sec = int(duration / 1000) self.duration_lbl.setText(str(datetime.timedelta(seconds=sec))) def setPlayPauseButton(self, state): if state == QtMultimedia.QMediaPlayer.PlaybackState.PlayingState: icon = QtWidgets.QStyle.StandardPixmap.SP_MediaPause else: icon = QtWidgets.QStyle.StandardPixmap.SP_MediaPlay self.play_pause_btn.setIcon(self.style().standardIcon(icon)) def isPlaying(self): return self.media_player.playbackState() == QtMultimedia.QMediaPlayer.PlaybackState.PlayingState def togglePlayPause(self): if self.isPlaying(): self.media_player.pause() else: self.media_player.play() def skipKeyPressed(self): self.playing_before_skip = self.isPlaying() if self.playing_before_skip: self.media_player.pause() def skipKeyReleased(self): if self.playing_before_skip: self.media_player.play() def skip(self, delta): new_position = max(min(self.seek_bar.value() + delta, self.seek_bar.maximum()), 0) self.setSeekBarPosition(new_position) self.position_debounce_timer.start() def setVideoPosition(self): self.media_player.setPosition(self.seek_bar.value()) class VideoKeyFilter(QtCore.QObject): key_pressed = QtCore.pyqtSignal() key_released = QtCore.pyqtSignal() skip = QtCore.pyqtSignal(int) def eventFilter(self, obj, event): if event.type() == QtCore.QEvent.Type.KeyPress: if delta := self.whichKey(event): if not event.isAutoRepeat(): self.key_pressed.emit() self.skip.emit(delta) return True if event.type() == QtCore.QEvent.Type.KeyRelease: if delta := self.whichKey(event): self.key_released.emit() return True return False def whichKey(self, event): # Returns how many milliseconds to move the video position, # depending on which key was pressed if event.key() == QtCore.Qt.Key.Key_Right: return 5000 if event.key() == QtCore.Qt.Key.Key_Left: return -5000 return None if __name__=="__main__": app = QtWidgets.QApplication([]) player = VideoPlayer("path_to_some_video.mp4") player.show() app.exec()
